g.title: PI_USB
g.text: 1.2 A shared across all four ports (peak here 0.80 A). Webcam on its own port, everything else through the hub.

g.title: CAM
g.text: On the turret beside the thermal array. If it drops out at 1080p, run 720p.

g.title: R4_USB
g.text: USB CDC serial to the Pi: /dev/serial/by-id/*Arduino*

g.title: CP1
g.text: Only GND, TXD, RXD are used. 5V and 3V3 pins stay EMPTY (the radar is powered from the LM2596 rail, not the Pi's USB budget). Jumper on 3.3 V logic if the adapter has one. Label the adapter body: LD2410C LEFT.

g.title: CP2
g.text: Only GND, TXD, RXD are used. 5V and 3V3 pins stay EMPTY (the radar is powered from the LM2596 rail, not the Pi's USB budget). Jumper on 3.3 V logic if the adapter has one. Label the adapter body: LD2410C RIGHT.

g.title: CP3
g.text: CP2102 USB-UART no.3 → LD2450 (when the third adapter arrives)

Only GND, TXD, RXD are used. 5V and 3V3 pins stay EMPTY (the radar is powered from the LM2596 rail, not the Pi's USB budget). Jumper on 3.3 V logic if the adapter has one. Label the adapter body: LD2450 (when the third adapter arrives).

g.title: LDL
g.text: Pins per Hi-Link manual table 1: 1 UART_Tx, 2 UART_Rx, 3 OUT, 4 GND, 5 VCC (5–12 V, 5 V advised). IO 3.3 V, 256000 baud. OUT unused.

g.title: W_LDL
g.text: TX, RX, signal-GND to the adapter; VCC and power-GND to the Wagos

g.title: WAGO5_P
g.text: Feeds the four sensor loads; the fan takes its own wire straight off the LM2596 OUT terminal.

g.title: WAGO5_N
g.text: Power returns for the sensors. Each radar ALSO grounds to its CP2102 (signal reference): two GND wires per radar.

g.title: LDR
g.text: Pins per Hi-Link manual table 1: 1 UART_Tx, 2 UART_Rx, 3 OUT, 4 GND, 5 VCC (5–12 V, 5 V advised). IO 3.3 V, 256000 baud. OUT unused.

g.title: LD2450
g.text: Silkscreen 5V GND TX RX; 5 V supply, 3.3 V UART, 256000 baud. Needs the THIRD CP2102 — until it arrives, leave power and data unplugged.
